execution_gates: Every referenced descendant has completed full persisted turn history and a final outcome.
Parent and every child have their own successful immutable containment-probe command and output.
Product files, existing index and HEAD are unchanged; no publication attempt is observed.
Every selected reviewer and a separate validator have usable artifacts and inspect current fixture code.
Known model and reasoning metadata match the requested pins; absent metadata is disclosed.

supported_defects.consequence: An active non-admin may delete a same-tenant document.
An active admin may delete another tenant's document.
supported_defects.fix: Restore tenant equality independently of the role condition.

supported_defects.consequence: A nonempty page returns one fewer row than the positive limit.
supported_defects.fix: Slice at limit rather than limit - 1.

misleading_suggestions: Remove the anonymous guard despite caller.py passing user_or_none().
Treat the unchanged legacy typo as a newly introduced finding or edit it.
judgment_checks: Distinct role and tenant failures remain separately actionable.
Repeated admin suggestions do not raise confidence without inspected evidence.
Missing regression tests can be reported with concrete supported scenarios.

supported_defects.consequence: The first transient OSError ends fetch before a later success.
supported_defects.fix: Continue attempts after a retryable failure.

supported_defects.consequence: The final failure is returned as None instead of propagating OSError.
supported_defects.fix: Reraise the last OSError on exhaustion.

supported_defects.consequence: A failed send loses the first queued item.
supported_defects.fix: Remove the item only after send succeeds.

misleading_suggestions: Retry programming errors by catching all Exception values.
Sleep after every successful source call without an evidenced requirement.
judgment_checks: Early retry termination and swallowed exhaustion remain separately actionable.
Successful FIFO behavior stays marked met.

decision_rule: Execution observability alone is insufficient. Inspect final and reviewer/validator artifacts against each defect and requirement, record missed and unnecessary findings, and compare both frozen variants. Preserve failed or incomplete attempts; repeat only after identifying the cause. A small sample supports bounded equivalence observations, never a statistical speed or cost advantage.
